newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwong Hing shrs end debut 21 percent up.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Hing shrs end debut 21 percent up.

text.p: Knitted fabrics maker Kwong Hing International Holdings Ltd shares closed their first trading day on Wednesday at HK$1.45, a 21 percent premium on their initial public offer price of HK$1.20.
Analysts said the stock benefitted from the recent strong performances of newly listed shares.
Kwong Hing shares hit a high of HK$1.56 before profit-taking crept in dragging prices down to HK$1.30, brokers said. They rebounded at the close as buying interests emerged at lows.
But analysts doubted whether the rise could keep going.
"The core business of the company is unattractive, its flotation size is relatively small and there is no special concept (selling point)," an analyst at a local house said.
"So I will not recommand my clients to chase the stock at the current price level," she said.
Kwong Hing provides fabric knitting, dyeing and setting services and manufactures and sells knit fabrics. Its 45-million share public offer was 8.35 times oversubscribed.
The company said the money raised from the new issue would be used to buy knitting, bleaching, dyeing and setting machineries, to upgrade its office information system and for working capital.
